applicability_conditions: 适用于金属熔体与渣之间的脱硫反应平衡；本文所用渣剂不含酸性氧化物组分，参与脱硫的主要组分为 CaO 和 MgO（合计约 40 wt.%），其余组分 CaF2 和 Al2O3 视为中性。
purpose: 该公式是脱硫反应平衡常数表达式的重排形式，用于将熔体中硫活度与渣中硫活度之比同氧活度之比及平衡常数 K 联系起来，说明金属中的硫含量与金属中氧浓度成正比、与渣碱度成反比。

symbols.meaning: activity of sulfur in the melt（熔体中硫的活度）
activity of sulfur in the slag（渣中硫的活度）
equilibrium constant（脱硫反应平衡常数）
activity of oxygen in the melt（熔体中氧的活度）
activity of oxygen in the slag（渣中氧的活度）

unmapped: It can be observed that the sulfur content of the metal is directly proportional to the concentration of the oxygen in the metal and inversely proportional to the basicity of the slag.

The flux used in the present work does not have any acid oxide component, and the major components taking part in the desulfurization reaction are CaO and MgO (total approximately 40 wt.%), while CaF2 and Al2O3 are neutral.
